definition: I. סִין proper name, of a location Sin , i.e. Pelusium , east frontier city of Egypt (Egyptian ' Imt = clay , of which סין is translated (compare Aramaic סְיָן clay ), according to Steind BAS i. 599 , who compare II ηλούσιον ( πηλός = dirt, mud ), compare Brugsch Dict. Géogr. 1081 ff. ); — Ezek 30:15 ( ᵐ5 Σαιν accusative), + v Ezek 30:16 , but here Co Toy read plausibly סון , i.e. סְוָן = Syene (see [ סְוָן ], סְוֵנֵה ), ᵐ5 συηνη . — On Pelusium see Bd Egypt.4 (1898), 169 .
